title: Disorderly Conduct
key_points: Improper behavior (fighting, threatening, violent or tumultuous behavior, or creating a hazardous condition) with purpose to cause, or recklessly creating, public inconvenience, annoyance or alarm.
Offensive language in a public place, unreasonably loud and offensively coarse or abusive, with the same purpose.
elements: (a) Improper behavior: the suspect engaged in fighting, threatening, violent or tumultuous behavior, or created a hazardous or physically dangerous condition by an act serving no legitimate purpose
OR (b) Offensive language: in a public place, used unreasonably loud and offensively coarse or abusive language, given the circumstances
With purpose to cause public inconvenience, annoyance or alarm, or recklessly creating a risk of it
It occurred in or affected a public place
